title: mubix-dev/pdf-rag-chat
summary: 该项目利用FastAPI、ChromaDB、fastembed和Groq构建了一个基于React的前端，实现了与PDF文件进行对话的功能。项目从头开始学习检索增强生成技术，核心技术包括模型训练、推理、向量索引和缓存机制。
description: My first RAG project — chat with your PDFs using FastAPI, ChromaDB, fastembed, and Groq, with a React frontend. Built to learn retrieval-augmented generation from scratch.
